# Test photos

Four photos from the held-out test split, reduced to 640 px, used to check that the service
classifies known photos correctly. They come from datasets licensed under CC BY 4.0:

| File | Source |
|---|---|
| `pothole.jpg` | RSD-BD v1, `Road damage data/Pot hole/50 (3).JPG` — Kowser, K. A. et al., Mendeley Data, DOI 10.17632/745n5wnt7v.1 |
| `crack.jpg` | RSD-BD v1, `Road damage data/Creak/41.JPG` — same source |
| `asphalt_damage.jpg` | RSD-BD v1, `Road damage data/Asphalt/asp(35).JPG` — same source |
| `no_damage.jpg` | Bangladesh Road Damage Detection Dataset v1, `normal_639` (letterbox bars removed) — Tanim, T. H., Khan, M. R., Moni, M. M. I., Mendeley Data, DOI 10.17632/ktnx66vtmc.1 |
